name: Margarita
description: The iconic Mexican cocktail of blanco tequila, triple sec, and fresh lime shaken and served in a salt-rimmed glass.
ingredients: a handful of fresh epazote, chopped
a generous spoonful of lime wedges
instructions: Combine the white rice and beef stock in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the smoked paprika and crumbled cotija cheese, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with Mexican crema, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
tips: Adjust the sweetness gradually, tasting as you go — you can always add more Mexican crema, but you cannot take it away.
Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
